data.name: Nicolle
data.gender_notes: Nicolle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nicolas is a Greek name derived from the Greek word nikos, meaning victory. The feminine form is Nicolle. In the New Testament, Nicholas is mentioned as a saint and bishop in Myra, Lycia. The name Nicolle carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nicolle usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carry the victorious spirit of love and faith within you.
data.etymology: Nicolle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicolle total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
